title: Apprentice Sales Advisor
description:
Start Date - 02.11.2026

Shift Pattern - Full Time

Start your future with EE - Where your voice could be the start of something big

What's in it for you:
- A great starting salary of £22,527 rising to £26,738 after completion of the apprenticeship. Plus, an uncapped commission scheme.
- An NVQ Level 2 in Customer Service following the completion of the apprenticeship (15 months)
- Huge discounts off your Mobile and Broadband packages, starting at £10 a month
- Huge discounts off other tech such as Smart watches, speakers, tv's, gaming consoles and subscriptions
- Discount codes to give out to friends and family
- Support to carve your own career path. We're passionate about helping our people grow the career they want
- Season Ticket Travel Loan - giving you the funds to pay for your travel to and from work up front
- Online GP: Access to a private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family

What you'll be doing:

At EE, we believe every customer interaction should be a positive experience. You'll speak with customers over the phone, getting to know what matters most to them, building strong relationships, and recommending the right EE products and services to suit their needs. You'll use your energy and ambition to thrive and meet goals, and grow your skills along the way. From the latest mobile tech and broadband, and smart home solutions, every conversation is a chance to make a real impact and grow your confidence.

As part of your apprenticeship, you'll complete a 15-month NVQ Level 2 in Customer Service. We'll support you every step of the way - including one dedicated study day a week, guidance from a college tutor, and extra coaching to help you feel confident in your role.

Why choose EE:

You don't need experience, all you need is a great attitude, a friendly voice, and the willingness to learn. We'll give you all the training you need and we're passionate about helping you kick start your career.

At EE, you're part of something bigger. You'll make friends, learn new skills, and build confidence every day. We're proud to be inclusive and welcome people from all backgrounds - because everyone belongs here.

Ready to make your mark? Apply now and let's start building your future.

title: Sales Advisor - Part Time
description:
Shift Pattern - 20 hours - Evenings
Location - Glasgow
Start date - 12.10.2026
Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE. Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.Our Glasgow team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.
What does being a sales advisor involve?You'll join a lively sales team in our Glasgow contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.
Forget what you've heard about salesDon't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?
Why you'll be better off at EE
GREAT MONEY - you start on £13,928.53 which goes up to £14,260.27 after 8 months.
UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, discounted parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Sports Sales Executive
description:
After clicking Apply, you'll be invited to create a profile on the Via website to complete your application. This doesn't guarantee you'll be matched to this specific role - Via reviews every application (AI first, then a human checks the fit) and shortlists the right candidates. Your profile also stays active for other relevant roles on the platform, and stays anonymous until you match. It takes just a few minutes.

Up to £30,000 Basic + Uncapped Commission

Year 1 OTE: £40,000-£60,000 Year 2 OTE: £50,000-£70,000

Glasgow Office-Based Full-Time Permanent

Via is supporting a leading corporate hospitality business to recruit ambitious Sales Executives to join its growing commercial team.

Are you a recent graduate with a passion for sport and some experience in sales, customer service or an office-based role? Looking for a career where your earning potential is in your hands and your progression is based on performance?

This is an exciting opportunity to begin your sales career with a business that delivers premium hospitality experiences at some of the world's biggest sporting events. You'll receive industry-leading training, ongoing coaching and genuine opportunities to progress into senior sales and leadership positions.

No previous experience in the sports or hospitality industry is required-just the ambition to succeed.

The Opportunity

As a Graduate Sales Executive, you'll build relationships with businesses across the UK, introducing them to exclusive hospitality experiences at iconic sporting events.

You'll learn how to identify new opportunities, develop your own client portfolio and manage the full sales process from initial conversation through to closing the deal.

Working alongside experienced sales professionals, you'll receive continuous coaching to help you maximise your earnings and accelerate your career.

What You'll Be Doing
- Learn how to generate new business through outbound calling, LinkedIn and market research
- Speak with business owners and senior decision-makers across a range of industries
- Build and manage your own pipeline of prospective clients
- Present premium corporate hospitality packages tailored to clients' needs
- Develop long-term client relationships
- Negotiate and close new business opportunities
- Manage bookings from initial enquiry through to confirmation
- Maintain accurate CRM records
- Achieve and exceed sales targets while developing your commercial skills

The Events You'll Be Selling

You'll work with premium hospitality packages for world-renowned events including:
- Formula 1
- Wimbledon
- Royal Ascot
- Six Nations
- Premier League Football
- International Cricket
- Rugby
- Horse Racing
- And many more

This Role Would Suit Someone Who Is
- Passionate about sport and major live events
- Competitive, ambitious and motivated by success
- Looking to build a long-term career in sales
- Confident speaking with new people
- Eager to learn in a fast-paced environment
- Motivated by uncapped commission and career progression

We're Looking For

We're particularly interested in candidates who have:
- A Bachelor's Degree in Sport, Sports Business, Sports Management or a related subject
- Up to 3 years' experience in sales, recruitment, customer service or another office-based commercial role
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
- Confidence speaking on the phone
- A resilient, target-driven mindset
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn

What's On Offer
- Up to £30,000 basic salary
- Uncapped commission
- Year 1 OTE of £40,000-£60,000
- Year 2 OTE of £50,000-£70,000
- Structured training programme
- Ongoing coaching and mentoring
- Clear progression into Senior Sales Executive and leadership roles
- Private BUPA health and dental insurance
- Pension and life assurance
- Perkbox membership
- 23 days annual leave, increasing to 26 with service
- Christmas office closure
- Monthly team socials
- Travelcard loan
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Refer-a-Friend bonus
- Long service rewards, including a paid sabbatical after 10 years

If you're a motivated graduate who enjoys building relationships, has a passion for sport and wants to launch a rewarding sales career with uncapped earning potential, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Account Manager
description:
Join a growing, internationally focused business where success is built on relationships, not hard-selling, and where your ability to influence, develop trust and grow client accounts will be genuinely rewarded. This is an opportunity for a commercially minded Account Manager to develop meaningful client partnerships, maximise earning potential, and play a key role in an ambitious company's continued growth.

Client Details

Our client is a growing Glasgow-based business that helps high-net-worth individuals and investors access and manage specialist alternative assets, providing a highly tailored and consultative service to clients across the UK and internationally. The company has built a strong reputation within its sector by putting client relationships at the heart of everything it does and delivering a premium, personalised customer experience. We have successfully placed several people into the business and have consistently received excellent feedback regarding the leadership team, culture, support, and overall earning potential.

Description

As part of continued growth, we're looking for an Account Manager who can build trust, develop relationships, and influence outcomes through credibility rather than hard-selling.

The Opportunity

This role would suit someone who enjoys working with people, understanding what motivates them, and guiding them through important commercial decisions.

You'll manage conversations with engaged prospective and existing clients, developing relationships over time and identifying opportunities to grow accounts. Success comes from asking the right questions, listening carefully, and communicating value effectively.

While relationship-building is central to the role, you'll also possess the commercial drive required to convert opportunities, grow revenue, and maximise your own bonus earnings.

What You'll Be Doing
- Building strong relationships with prospective and existing clients.
- Developing a deep understanding of client objectives and requirements.
- Managing the sales process from initial enquiry through to completion.
- Nurturing opportunities and maintaining regular client contact.
- Identifying opportunities to increase account value and strengthen client relationships.
- Delivering a consultative, professional and highly personalised client experience.
- Working towards individual targets and performance objectives.

Profile

A successful Account Manager should have:
- Experience in an Account Management, Business Development, Relationship Management or consultative sales role.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- A natural ability to build rapport and earn trust.
- Commercial awareness and the confidence to ask for the business when the opportunity is right.
- Self-motivation and a desire to succeed financially.
- Professional, articulate and highly organised.
- Someone who prefers relationship-led selling over aggressive sales tactics.

Job Offer
- Basic salary circa 40,000.
- Attractive bonus structure with strong earning potential.
- A growing and ambitious business with an international reach.
- Supportive leadership team and collaborative culture.
- Genuine opportunity to develop your career as the business continues to expand.
- Glasgow office location with a hybrid arrangement of 4 days per week in the office.

If you're a commercially minded relationship builder who enjoys winning business through trust, influence and credibility rather than pressure selling, we'd love to hear from you.
